items.period: Shuowen seal-script style; later script tradition, not a dated artifact
items.tradition: Small seal script, modern vector reconstruction
items.caption: A modern vector reconstruction of 西 in Shuowen seal-script style, illustrating a later standardized form tradition.
items.alt: Black seal-script form of 西 centered on a plain background.
items.selection_reason: The exact Commons description identifies the character and script style and states public-domain terms; this is a useful later-form comparison for the graphic-history account. It is not an ancient artifact image.
items.rights: The Commons file page labels this vector representation public domain and cites its source attribution to Richard Sears character data.

limitations.text: Only the modern seal-script reconstruction has verified reuse provenance among inspected candidate images. It was not visually inspected in this research stage, and the exact upstream file fetch failed in the web tool; downstream image validation is needed before final selection.
Academia Sinica displays earlier stage labels and glyphs, but its rights notice does not grant general reuse of page images, so no Academia Sinica image is proposed.
